SELECT i.id,COALESCE(f.name,i.frame) AS frame,COALESCE(c.name,i.customer) AS customer, i.time,i.number,i.total,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(b.money) FROM imy_bill b WHERE b.pid=i.id),0) AS money, COALESCE(p.name,i.people) AS people,CAST(i.examine AS SIGNED) AS examine, CAST(i.nucleus AS SIGNED) AS nucleus,COALESCE(u.name,i.user) AS user,i.data FROM imy i LEFT JOIN frame f ON f.id=i.frame LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.id=i.customer LEFT JOIN people p ON p.id=i.people LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id=i.user
AND i.frame=#{organization} AND (i.customer=#{query.customer} OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.customer},'%') OR c.number LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.customer},'%')) AND DATE(i.time) >= #{query.beginTime} AND DATE(i.time) <= #{query.endTime} AND i.number LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.number},'%') AND (i.people=#{query.people} OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.people},'%')) AND (i.user=#{query.user} OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.user},'%')) AND i.examine=#{query.examine} AND i.nucleus=#{query.nucleus} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM imy_info d WHERE d.pid=i.id AND d.account=#{query.account}) AND i.data LIKE CONCAT('%',#{query.data},'%')
ORDER BY i.time DESC,i.id DESC
